pickup_log.setting.corner.tooltip: Where the list shows. The newest line is the one nearest the edge of the screen. It gives way to the debug screen (F3).
pickup_log.setting.seconds.tooltip: How long a line stays before it fades out. Picking up more of the same item adds to its line and starts its time again.
pickup_log.setting.max_entries.tooltip: How many lines the list shows at once. A new item past this pushes out the oldest line.
pickup_log.setting.icons.tooltip: Show each item's icon beside its line.
pickup_log.setting.background.tooltip: A dark box behind each line, so it reads on any background.
pickup_log.setting.all_gains.tooltip: Off: only items you pick up from the ground. On: anything new in your inventory too, such as items from /give or a kit. Nothing is listed while a screen (a chest, your inventory, chat) is open.
